props.name: positionState
props.description:
Внешний стейт позиции [position, setPosition].
Если не передан, будет использован внутренний стейт. Не используется для интеграции с localStorage. Данное поле отвечает за полное внешнее управление позицией

props.name: resizable
props.type: boolean | ((placement: AiAgentPopoverPlacement) => Partial<{ disabled?: boolean | undefined; directions?: ResizeDirections | undefined; defaultSize?: { width?: number | undefined; height?: number | undefined; } | undefined; minWidth?: number | undefined; minHeight?: number | undefined; maxWidth?: number | undefined; maxHeight?: number | undefined; icons?: { topRight?: React.ReactNode; bottomRight?…
props.description:
Включить / настроить resizable-режим.
- `true`: включить с дефолтной конфигурацией (иконка ресайза автоматически позиционируется в зависимости от placement).
- `(placement: AiAgentPopoverPlacement) => config`: функция для кастомной конфигурации. Принимает текущий placement,
  возвращает частичную конфигурацию, которая мержится с дефолтной.

props.name: targetDataAttributes

props.name: useStorage
props.description:
Сохранять ли позицию в localStorage.
- `true`: автосохранение с ключом `ai-agent-popover-position`.
- `string`: кастомный ключ (например, `my-popover-position`).
- `false`: отключено.

<BlockGradientScroll variant="white" className="custom-gradient-box">

          variant="white"
          style={{
            flex: 1,
            maxHeight: 300,
            overflowY: 'auto',
            padding: 24,
            borderRadius: 8,
            border: `1px solid ${outlineAccent}`,
          }}
        >
          {generateItems(6)}
        </BlockGradientScroll>

MassActions.name: MassActions
MassActions.description:
Базовый адаптивный компонент панели массовых действий
Независим от таблицы - может использоваться с любым контейнером

Используется для внутренней логики видимости панели (если show не указан)
Если selectedCount === 0 и show не указан, панель не отображается

props.name: bottom

По умолчанию: 16px для standalone, 24px для таблицы

Опционально - для standalone версии не используется

props.name: minPadding
props.description:
Минимальный отступ панели от краев контейнера (в пикселях)
Используется для:
- CSS padding панели (симметрично: minPadding слева и справа)
- Расчетов компрессии (максимальная ширина панели с учетом отступов)
- Позиционирования (гарантирует минимальный отступ от левого края контейнера)
По умолчанию: 16px для standalone, 24px для таблицы

props.name: show
props.description:
Явный контроль видимости панели
Если указан, имеет приоритет над автоматической логикой на основе selectedCount
Позволяет показывать панель даже при selectedCount === 0
По умолчанию: undefined (используется логика selectedCount > 0)

НЕ задавать для standalone — там компактность определяется по ширине вьюпорта (`down('xl')`).

PageTitle.name: PageTitle
PageTitle.description:
Компонент `PageTitle` предназначен для отображения заголовка страницы с опциональными breadcrumbs, кнопкой «назад», заголовком, подзаголовком и правым блоком действий.
Компонент автоматически обрабатывает длинные тексты через `TypographyWithAutoTooltip`, показывая тултип при обрезке.
- `title` — заголовок страницы (текст). Оборачивается в `TypographyWithAutoTooltip` с `variant="H2"` и `bold={true}`.
- `subtitle` — подзаголовок/описание страницы (текст). Оборачивается в `TypographyWithAutoTooltip` с `variant="BodyS"`.
- `titleTypographyProps` / `subtitleTypographyProps` — пропсы для настройки `TypographyWithAutoTooltip` (включая `tooltipText`, `tooltipProps`, `lines` и другие).
- `breadcrumbs` — пропсы для компонента `Breadcrumbs`. По умолчанию `size='m'`, но можно переопределить.
- `showBackButton` / `onBackClick` — управление отображением кнопки «назад» слева от заголовка.
- `titleSlot` — кастомный слот правее заголовка.
- `rightSlot` — контент справа, прижатый к правому краю и к нижней границе компонента.

SplitIconButton.name: SplitIconButton
SplitIconButton.description:
SplitIconButton — пара кнопок-иконок: основное действие слева и кнопка-шеврон
справа, открывающая дропдаун (паттерн split button). Клики по каждой
обрабатываются отдельно (onIconClick / onChevronClick), шеврон с items
открывает дропдаун. Предназначен для кастомных слотов контрл-блока таблицы:
editModeLeftSlot и customFeatures.

Дропдаун под капотом — TableDropdown, поэтому компонент работает внутри
контекста TableCanvas и подхватывает rowSize таблицы автоматически (ширина и
размер списка). Размеры иконок задаёт потребитель снаружи.

props.name: getCellsForSelection
props.type: true | ((selection: Rectangle, abortSignal: AbortSignal) => GetCellsThunk | CellArray) | undefined
props.description:
Used to fetch large amounts of cells at once. Used for copy/paste, if unset copy will not work.

`getCellsForSelection` is called when the user copies a selection to the clipboard or the data editor needs to
inspect data which may be outside the curently visible range. It must return a two-dimensional array (an array of
rows, where each row is an array of cells) of the cells in the selection's rectangle. Note that the rectangle can
include cells that are not currently visible.

If `true` is passed instead of a callback, the data grid will internally use the `getCellContent` callback to
provide a basic implementation of `getCellsForSelection`. This can make it easier to light up more data grid
functionality, but may have negative side effects if your data source is not able to handle being queried for
data outside the normal window.

If `getCellsForSelection` returns a thunk, the data may be loaded asynchronously, however the data grid may be
unable to properly react to column spans when performing range selections. Copying large amounts of data out of
the grid will depend on the performance of the thunk as well.

props.name: headerIcons
props.description:
Additional header icons for use by `GridColumn`.

Providing custom header icons to the data grid must be done with a somewhat non-standard mechanism to allow
theming and scaling. The `headerIcons` property takes a dictionary which maps icon names to functions which can
take a foreground and background color and returns back a string representation of an svg. The svg should contain
a header similar to this `<svg width="20" height="20" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">` and
interpolate the fg/bg colors into the string.

We recognize this process is not fantastic from a graphics workflow standpoint, improvements are very welcome
here.

props.type: boolean | ((target: Item, values: readonly (readonly string[])[]) => boolean) | undefined
props.description:
Called when data is pasted into the grid. If left undefined, the `DataEditor` will operate in a
fallback mode and attempt to paste the text buffer into the current cell assuming the current cell is not
readonly and can accept the data type. If `onPaste` is set to false or the function returns false, the grid will
simply ignore paste. If `onPaste` evaluates to true the grid will attempt to split the data by tabs and newlines
and paste into available cells.

The grid will not attempt to add additional rows if more data is pasted then can fit. In that case it is
advisable to simply return false from onPaste and handle the paste manually.

props.name: getCellsForSelection
props.type: true | ((selection: Rectangle, abortSignal: AbortSignal) => GetCellsThunk | CellArray) | undefined
props.description:
Used to fetch large amounts of cells at once. Used for copy/paste, if unset copy will not work.

`getCellsForSelection` is called when the user copies a selection to the clipboard or the data editor needs to
inspect data which may be outside the curently visible range. It must return a two-dimensional array (an array of
rows, where each row is an array of cells) of the cells in the selection's rectangle. Note that the rectangle can
include cells that are not currently visible.

If `true` is passed instead of a callback, the data grid will internally use the `getCellContent` callback to
provide a basic implementation of `getCellsForSelection`. This can make it easier to light up more data grid
functionality, but may have negative side effects if your data source is not able to handle being queried for
data outside the normal window.

If `getCellsForSelection` returns a thunk, the data may be loaded asynchronously, however the data grid may be
unable to properly react to column spans when performing range selections. Copying large amounts of data out of
the grid will depend on the performance of the thunk as well.

props.name: headerIcons
props.description:
Additional header icons for use by `GridColumn`.

Providing custom header icons to the data grid must be done with a somewhat non-standard mechanism to allow
theming and scaling. The `headerIcons` property takes a dictionary which maps icon names to functions which can
take a foreground and background color and returns back a string representation of an svg. The svg should contain
a header similar to this `<svg width="20" height="20" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">` and
interpolate the fg/bg colors into the string.

We recognize this process is not fantastic from a graphics workflow standpoint, improvements are very welcome
here.

readonly and can accept the data type. If `onPaste` is set to false or the function returns false, the grid will

advisable to simply return false from onPaste and handle the paste manually.

props.name: columns

props.description: The primary callback for getting cell data into the data grid.

props.name: allowedFillDirections
props.description: Controls which directions fill is allowed in.

props.name: cellActivationBehavior
props.description:
Determines when a cell is considered activated and will emit the `onCellActivated` event. Generally an activated
cell will open to edit mode.

props.name: coercePasteValue
props.type: ((val: string, cell: GridCell) => GridCell | undefined) | undefined
props.description: Allows coercion of pasted values.

props.name: columnSelect
props.description: {@inheritDoc rangeSelect}

props.name: columnSelectionBlending
props.description: {@inheritDoc rangeSelectionBlending}

props.name: columnSelectionMode
props.description:
Determines if column selection requires a modifier key to enable multi-selection or not. In auto mode it adapts to
touch or mouse environments automatically, in multi-mode it always acts as if the multi key (Ctrl) is pressed.

props.name: copyHeaders
props.description: Add table headers to copied data.

props.name: customRenderers
props.description: An array of custom renderers which can be used to extend the data grid.

props.name: drawGroupHeader
props.description:
Overrides the rendering of a group header. The grid will call this for every group header it needs to render.
Group header rendering is not as well optimized because they do not redraw as often, but very heavy drawing
methods can negatively impact horizontal scrolling performance.

It is possible to return `false` after rendering just a background and the regular foreground rendering
will happen.

props.name: drawHeader
props.description:
Overrides the rendering of a header. The grid will call this for every header it needs to render. Header
rendering is not as well optimized because they do not redraw as often, but very heavy drawing methods can
negatively impact horizontal scrolling performance.

It is possible to return `false` after rendering just a background and the regular foreground rendering
will happen.

props.name: editOnType
props.description: Determines if the data editor should immediately begin editing when the user types on a selected cell

props.name: editorBloom
props.description: Allows overriding the default amount of bloom (the size growth of the overlay editor)

props.name: experimental
props.type: { readonly disableAccessibilityTree?: boolean | undefined; readonly disableMinimumCellWidth?: boolean | undefined; readonly paddingRight?: number | undefined; readonly paddingBottom?: number | undefined; readonly enableFirefoxRescaling?: boolean | undefined; readonly enableSafariRescaling?: boolean | undefined; readonly kineticScrollPerfHack?: boolean | undefined; readonly isSubGrid?: boolean | un…
props.description: Experimental features

props.name: fillHandle
props.description: Enabled/disables the fill handle.

props.name: fixedShadowX
props.description: Enables or disables the overlay shadow when scrolling horizontally

props.name: fixedShadowY
props.description: Enables or disables the overlay shadow when scrolling vertical

props.name: freezeColumns
props.description:
The number of columns which should remain in place when scrolling horizontally. The row marker column, if
enabled is always frozen and is not included in this count.

props.name: getCellsForSelection
props.type: true | ((selection: Rectangle, abortSignal: AbortSignal) => GetCellsThunk | CellArray) | undefined
props.description:
Used to fetch large amounts of cells at once. Used for copy/paste, if unset copy will not work.

`getCellsForSelection` is called when the user copies a selection to the clipboard or the data editor needs to
inspect data which may be outside the curently visible range. It must return a two-dimensional array (an array of
rows, where each row is an array of cells) of the cells in the selection's rectangle. Note that the rectangle can
include cells that are not currently visible.

If `true` is passed instead of a callback, the data grid will internally use the `getCellContent` callback to
provide a basic implementation of `getCellsForSelection`. This can make it easier to light up more data grid
functionality, but may have negative side effects if your data source is not able to handle being queried for
data outside the normal window.

If `getCellsForSelection` returns a thunk, the data may be loaded asynchronously, however the data grid may be
unable to properly react to column spans when performing range selections. Copying large amounts of data out of
the grid will depend on the performance of the thunk as well.

props.name: getGroupDetails
props.description: Provides additional details about groups to extend group functionality.

props.name: getRowThemeOverride
props.type: ((row: number, groupRow: number, contentRow: number) => Partial<Theme> | undefined) | undefined
props.description: Allows overriding the theme of any row

props.name: gridSelection
groupHeaderHeight
props.description: Controls the header of the group header row

props.name: headerHeight
props.description: Controls the height of the header row

props.name: headerIcons
props.description:
Additional header icons for use by `GridColumn`.

Providing custom header icons to the data grid must be done with a somewhat non-standard mechanism to allow
theming and scaling. The `headerIcons` property takes a dictionary which maps icon names to functions which can
take a foreground and background color and returns back a string representation of an svg. The svg should contain
a header similar to this `<svg width="20" height="20" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">` and
interpolate the fg/bg colors into the string.

We recognize this process is not fantastic from a graphics workflow standpoint, improvements are very welcome
here.

props.name: highlightRegions
props.description: Highlight regions provide hints to users about relations between cells and selections.

props.name: imageEditorOverride
props.description:
Used to provide an override to the default image editor for the data grid. `provideEditor` may be a better
choice for most people.

props.name: initialSize
props.description:
Provides an initial size for the grid which can prevent a flicker on load if the initial size is known prior to
layout.

props.name: isDraggable
props.description: Determines what can be dragged using HTML drag and drop

props.name: isOutsideClick
props.description:
Custom predicate function to decide whether the click event occurred outside the grid
Especially used when custom editor is opened with the portal and is outside the grid, but there is no possibility
to add a class "click-outside-ignore"
If this function is supplied and returns false, the click event is ignored

props.name: keybindings
props.description: Determins which keybindings are enabled.

props.name: markdownDivCreateNode
props.description:
If specified, it will be used to render Markdown, instead of the default Markdown renderer used by the Grid.
You'll want to use this if you need to process your Markdown for security purposes, or if you want to use a
renderer with different Markdown features.

props.name: maxColumnAutoWidth
props.description: The maximum width a column can be automatically sized to.

props.name: maxColumnWidth
props.description: The maximum width a column can be resized to.

props.name: minColumnWidth
props.description: The minimum width a column can be resized to.

props.name: onCellActivated
props.description: Emitted when a cell is activated, by pressing Enter, Space or double clicking it.

props.name: onCellClicked
props.description: Emitted when a cell is clicked.

props.name: onCellContextMenu
props.description: Emitted when a cell should show a context menu. Usually right click.

props.name: onCellEdited
props.description: Emitted whenever a cell edit is completed.

props.name: onCellsEdited
props.description: Emitted whenever a cell mutation is completed and provides all edits inbound as a single batch.

props.name: onColumnAppended
props.description: Emitted whenever a column append operation is requested. Append location can be set in callback.

props.name: onColumnMoved
props.description:
Called when the user finishes moving a column. `startIndex` is the index of the column that was moved, and
`endIndex` is the index at which it should end up. Note that you have to effect the move of the column, and pass
the reordered columns back in the `columns` property.

props.name: onColumnProposeMove
props.description: Called when the user is dragging a column and proposes to move it to a new location. Return `false` to prevent

props.name: onColumnResize
props.type: ((column: GridColumn, newSize: number, colIndex: number, newSizeWithGrow: number) => void) | undefined
props.description:
Called when the user is resizing a column. `newSize` is the new size of the column. Note that you have change
the size of the column in the `GridColumn` and pass it back to the grid in the `columns` property.

props.name: onColumnResizeEnd
props.type: ((column: GridColumn, newSize: number, colIndex: number, newSizeWithGrow: number) => void) | undefined
props.description: Called when the user finishes resizing a column. `newSize` is the new size of the column.

props.name: onColumnResizeStart
props.type: ((column: GridColumn, newSize: number, colIndex: number, newSizeWithGrow: number) => void) | undefined
props.description: Called when the user starts resizing a column. `newSize` is the new size of the column.

props.name: onDelete
props.description: Emitted whenever the user has requested the deletion of the selection.

props.name: onDragStart
props.description:
If `isDraggable` is set, the grid becomes HTML draggable, and `onDragStart` will be called when dragging starts.
You can use this to build a UI where the user can drag the Grid around.

props.name: onDrop
props.type: ((cell: Item, dataTransfer: DataTransfer | null) => void) | undefined
props.description: Called when a HTML Drag and Drop event is ended on the data grid.

props.name: onFillPattern
props.description:
Emitted whenever the user initiats a pattern fill using the fill handle. This event provides both
a patternSource region and a fillDestination region, and can be prevented.

props.name: onFinishedEditing
props.type: ((newValue: GridCell | undefined, movement: Item) => void) | undefined
props.description: Emitted when editing has finished, regardless of data changing or not.

props.name: onGridSelectionChange
props.description:
Emitted whenever the grid selection changes. Specifying
this function will make the grid’s selection controlled, so
so you will need to specify {@link gridSelection} as well. See
the "Controlled Selection" example for details.

props.name: onGroupHeaderClicked
props.description: Emitted when a group header is clicked.

props.name: onGroupHeaderContextMenu
props.description: Emitted when a group header should show a context menu. Usually right click.

props.name: onGroupHeaderRenamed
props.description: Emitted whe the user wishes to rename a group.

props.name: onHeaderClicked
props.description: Emitted when a column header should show a context menu. Usually right click.

props.name: onHeaderContextMenu
props.description: Emitted when a column header should show a context menu. Usually right click.

props.name: onHeaderIndicatorClick
props.description: Emitted when a header indicator icon is clicked.

props.name: onHeaderMenuClick
props.description: Emitted when a header menu disclosure indicator is clicked.

props.name: onItemHovered
props.description: Emitted when an item is hovered.

props.name: onKeyDown
props.description: Emitted when the canvas receives a key down event.

props.name: onKeyUp
props.description: Emitted when the canvas receives a key up event.

props.name: onMouseMove
props.description: Fires whenever the mouse moves

props.name: onPaste
props.type: boolean | ((target: Item, values: readonly (readonly string[])[]) => boolean) | undefined
props.description:
Called when data is pasted into the grid. If left undefined, the `DataEditor` will operate in a
fallback mode and attempt to paste the text buffer into the current cell assuming the current cell is not
readonly and can accept the data type. If `onPaste` is set to false or the function returns false, the grid will
simply ignore paste. If `onPaste` evaluates to true the grid will attempt to split the data by tabs and newlines
and paste into available cells.

The grid will not attempt to add additional rows if more data is pasted then can fit. In that case it is
advisable to simply return false from onPaste and handle the paste manually.

props.name: onRowAppended
props.description: Emitted whenever a row append operation is requested. Append location can be set in callback.

props.name: onRowMoved
props.description:
Called whenever a row re-order operation is completed. Setting the callback enables re-ordering by dragging the
first column of a row.

props.name: onSearchClose
props.description: Emitted when the search window close event is triggered.

props.name: onSearchResultsChanged
props.type: ((results: readonly Item[], navIndex: number) => void) | undefined
props.description: Emitted whenever the search results for the current search field changes.

props.name: onSearchValueChange
props.description: Emitted when the search value changes.

props.name: onSelectionCleared
props.description: Emitted when the grid selection is cleared.

props.name: onVisibleRegionChanged
props.type: ((range: Rectangle, tx: number, ty: number, extras: { selected?: Item | undefined; freezeRegion?: Rectangle | undefined; freezeRegions?: readonly Rectangle[] | undefined; }) => void) | undefined
props.description: Emitted whenever the visible cells change, usually due to scrolling.

props.name: overscrollX
props.description:
The overscroll properties are used to allow the grid to scroll past the logical end of the content by a fixed
number of pixels. This is useful particularly on the X axis if you allow for resizing columns as it can make
resizing the final column significantly easier.

props.name: overscrollY
props.description: {@inheritDoc overscrollX}

props.name: portalElementRef
props.description: Allows overriding the default portal element.

props.name: preventDiagonalScrolling
props.description: Set to true to prevent any diagonal scrolling.

props.name: provideEditor
props.description: Callback for providing a custom editor for a cell.

props.name: rangeSelect
props.description:
Controls if multi-selection is allowed. If disabled, shift/ctrl/command clicking will work as if no modifiers
are pressed.

When range select is set to cell, only one cell may be selected at a time. When set to rect one one rect at a
time. The multi variants allow for multiples of the rect or cell to be selected.

props.name: rangeSelectionBlending
props.description:
Controls which types of selections can exist at the same time in the grid. If selection blending is set to
exclusive, the grid will clear other types of selections when the exclusive selection is made. By default row,
column, and range selections are exclusive.

props.name: rangeSelectionColumnSpanning
props.description: Controls if range selection is allowed to span columns.

props.name: resizeIndicator
props.description:
Controls the resize indicator behavior.

- `full` will show the resize indicator on the full height.
- `header` will show the resize indicator only on the header.
- `none` will not show the resize indicator.

props.name: rightElement
props.description:
The right element is a DOM node which can be inserted at the end of the horizontal scroll region. This can be
used to create a right handle panel, make a big add button, or display messages.

props.name: rightElementProps
props.type: { readonly sticky?: boolean | undefined; readonly fill?: boolean | undefined; } | undefined
props.description:
If `rightElementProps.sticky` is set to true the right element will be visible at all times, otherwise the user
will need to scroll to the end to reveal it.

If `rightElementProps.fill` is set, the right elements container will fill to consume all remaining space (if
any) at the end of the grid. This does not play nice with growing columns.

props.name: rowGrouping
props.description: Controls the grouping of rows to be drawn in the grid.

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: Determins the height of each row.

props.name: rowMarkers
props.description:
Determines if row markers should be automatically added to the grid.
Interactive row markers allow the user to select a row.

- "clickable-number" renders a number that can be clicked to
 select the row
- "both" causes the row marker to show up as a number but
 reveal a checkbox when the marker is hovered.

props.name: rowSelect
props.description: {@inheritDoc rangeSelect}

props.name: rowSelectionBlending
props.description: {@inheritDoc rangeSelectionBlending}

props.name: rowSelectionMode
props.description:
Determines if row selection requires a modifier key to enable multi-selection or not. In auto mode it adapts to
touch or mouse environments automatically, in multi-mode it always acts as if the multi key (Ctrl) is pressed.

props.description: If set to true, the data grid will attempt to scroll to keep the selction in view

props.description:

props.name: smoothScrollY
props.description:
Controls smooth scrolling in the data grid. If smooth scrolling is not enabled the grid will always be cell
aligned.

props.name: spanAlign
props.description:
Выравнивание текста в объединённых ячейках шапки по умолчанию.
Можно переопределить на колонке (`spanGroupHeaderAlign`) или на группе (`getGroupDetails().spanAlign`).

props.name: spanGroupHeader
props.description:
Grid-дефолт слитной шапки: включает `spanGroupHeader` у ВСЕХ листовых колонок (без
группы) — не нужно ставить флаг на каждую. Точечно перекрывается на колонке
(`spanGroupHeader: true/false`). Колонки с группой проп не трогает.

props.name: spanRangeBehavior
props.description: If set to `default`, `gridSelection` will be coerced to always include full spans.

props.name: spanShallowGroups
props.description:
Объединяет (rowspan) пустые нижние ряды у «мелких» групп — тех, что заканчиваются
выше самого глубокого уровня групп, — в одну высокую ячейку вместо пустой полосы
под заголовком. Точечно на группе можно переопределить через `getGroupDetails().span`
(поставить `false`, чтобы отключить для конкретной группы). Не задано → как раньше.

FormAutocomplete.name: FormAutocomplete
FormAutocomplete.description:
FormAutocomplete относится к группе mutation-form элементов. Он расширяет возможности
 компонента Autocomplete

props.name: afterList
props.description: Ячейка для контента в конце выпадающего списка.

props.name: beforeList
props.description: Ячейка для контента в начале выпадающего списка.

props.name: contentLeft
props.description: Слот для контента слева.

props.name: contentRight
props.description: Слот для контента справа.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Значение поля ввода по-умолчанию.

props.name: filter
props.description: Коллбэк фильтра подсказок.

props.name: flip
props.description: Отображение выпадающего списка сверху, если снизу недостаточно места.

props.name: hasDivider
props.description: отобразить ли divider

props.name: hasRequiredIndicator
props.description: Флаг наличия индикатора обязательности поля

props.name: hintContentLeft
props.description: Слот для контента слева, например `Icon`.

props.name: hintHasArrow
props.description: Видимость стрелки (хвоста).

props.name: hintOffset
props.description: Отступ окна относительно элемента, у которого оно вызвано.

props.name: hintPlacement
props.description: Направление раскрытия тултипа.

props.name: hintPortal
props.description: Портал для окна подсказки. Принимает id контейнера или ref.

props.name: hintTargetIcon
props.description:
Иконка, рядом с которым произойдет вызов всплывающего окна.
Если свойство не задано, применится иконка по умолчанию.

props.name: hintTargetPlacement
props.description:
Расположение иконки подсказки, когда отсутствует label
или же он имеет labelPlacement='inner'.

props.name: hintText
props.description: Текст тултипа

props.name: hintTrigger
props.description: Способ открытия тултипа - наведение или клик мышью

props.name: hintWidth
props.description: Ширина окна (в rem).

props.name: keepPlaceholder
props.description: Одновременно отображает label и placeholder (при пустом вводе)

props.name: leftHelper
props.description: Вспомогательный текст снизу слева для поля ввода.

props.name: listMaxHeight
props.description: Максимальная высота выпадающего списка подсказок.

props.name: listWidth
props.description: Ширина выпадающего списка подсказок.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Callback при нажатии на кнопку очистки поля ввода.

props.name: onScroll
props.description: Коллбэк, срабатывающий при скролле.

props.name: onSearch
props.type: (((value: string, event?: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement> | undefined) => void) & ((value: string, event?: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement> | undefined) => void)) | undefined
props.description: Callback по нажатию Enter

props.name: optional
props.description: Флаг необязательности поля

props.name: optionalText
props.description: Подпись для указания необязательности поля

props.name: portal
props.description: Портал для выпадающего списка. Принимает id контейнера или ref.

props.name: renderItem
props.description: Callback для кастомной настройки элемента в выпадающем списке.

props.name: renderList
props.description: Коллбэк для рендера кастомного списка подсказок.

props.name: renderListEnd
props.description: Коллбэк для рендера элемента в конце выпадающего списка.

props.name: requiredPlacement
props.description: Задает выравнивание индикатора обязательности поля

props.name: rightHelper
props.description: Вспомогательный текст снизу справа для поля ввода.

props.name: rootClassName
props.description: ClassName для внешней обертки компонента.

props.name: rootStyle
props.description: Style для внешней обертки компонента.

props.name: suggestions
props.description: Массив подсказок.

props.name: textAfter
props.description: Слот для вспомогательного текста справа.

props.name: textBefore
props.description: Слот для вспомогательного текста слева.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Минимальное число введенных символов, при котором открывается дропдаун.

props.name: titleCaption
props.description: Метка-подпись к элементу справа.

props.name: virtual
props.description: Виртуализация в выпадающем списке.

props.name: zIndex
props.description: CSS-свойство z-index для выпадающего списка.

props.name: clear
props.description: view применяется с clear-токенами

props.description: Title и description в одну строку или с переносом строк

значения дат выраженные в миллисекундах, например:
```
...
options: {
 max: {
     value: new Date().getTime(),
     message: "Указанная дата за пределами максимально доступной"
 }
}
```

FormDatePickerRange.name: FormDatePickerRange
FormDatePickerRange.description:
[FormDatePickerRange](url) относится к группе mutation-form элементов. Он расширяет возможности
компонента [DatePicker.Range](https://plasma.sberdevices.ru/sdds-finai/components/datepicker/)
библиотеки [sdds-finai](https://plasma.sberdevices.ru/sdds-finai/) для работы с диапазонами дат в формах.

### Основные особенности:
- Встроенная валидация формата дат (сообщение через `invalidFormatMessage`)
- Поддержка обязательного заполнения (`required`)
- Контроль допустимых диапазонов дат
- Интеграция с react-hook-form

### Валидация диапазонов:
Для ограничения выбора дат используйте:
```tsx
<FormDatePickerRange
  options={{
    min: {
      value: new Date(2024, 0, 1).getTime(),
      message: "Минимальная дата - 1 января 2024"
    },
    max: {
      value: new Date(2024, 11, 31).getTime(),
      message: "Максимальная дата - 31 декабря 2024"
    }
  }}
/>
```

### Обязательное поле:
```tsx
// Простое указание обязательности
<FormDatePickerRange options={{ required: true }} />

// С кастомным сообщением
<FormDatePickerRange
  options={{
    required: "Пожалуйста, укажите диапазон дат"
  }}
/>
```

### Кастомная валидация:
```tsx
<FormDatePickerRange
  options={{
    validate: {
      minDuration: (value) =>
        (new Date(value.dateTo) - new Date(value.dateFrom)) < 7 * 86400000
          ? "Минимальный период - 7 дней"
          : true,
      noWeekends: (value) =>
        [0, 6].includes(new Date(value.dateFrom).getDay())
          ? "Нельзя начинать в выходные"
          : true
    }
  }}
/>
```

### Приоритеты валидации:
1. Проверка обязательности заполнения
2. Валидация формата дат
3. Проверка минимальных/максимальных значений
4. Кастомные валидаторы

CanvasInteractionOptions.name: CanvasInteractionOptions
CanvasInteractionOptions.definition:
export interface CanvasInteractionOptions {
  /**
   * Как клик по этой зоне влияет на выделение таблицы.
   *
   * `normal` — таблица ведет себя обычно: клик может сделать ячейку активной.
   *
   * `keep` — текущее выделение сохраняется: клик по этой зоне не переключает
   * active cell. Это основной режим для кнопок действия внутри ячейки.
   */
  selection?: 'normal' | 'keep';

  /**
   * Дойдет ли клик до `tableConfig.onCellClicked`.
   *
   * `normal` — после canvas `onClick` таблица получит обычный `onCellClicked`.
   *
   * `stop` — клик остается внутри canvas-элемента, внешний
   * `tableConfig.onCellClicked` не вызывается.
   */
  cellClick?: 'normal' | 'stop';

  /**
   * Как клик по этой зоне влияет на editor ячейки.
   *
   * `normal` — не вмешиваться: таблица ведет себя как обычно для этой ячейки.
   *
   * `never` — клик по этой зоне не должен открывать editor.
   *
   * `open-on-click` — клик по этой зоне должен открыть editor этой же ячейки.
   * В текущей реализации поддерживается только текущая ячейка, потому что
   * editor открывается через штатный click-путь таблицы.
   */
  editor?: 'normal' | 'never' | 'open-on-click';

  /**
   * Как правый клик / context menu ведет себя на этой зоне.
   *
   * `normal` — обычное поведение таблицы.
   *
   * `keep-selection` — context menu разрешен, но текущее выделение не меняется.
   *
   * `none` — context menu для этой зоны не открывается.
   */
  contextMenu?: 'normal' | 'keep-selection' | 'none';
}
